questions.question: On what date did CDSCO issue the 2024 new drug approval for Vonoprazan fumarate bulk drug and Vonoprazan 10mg/20mg tablets?
questions.answer: The approval for Vonoprazan fumarate bulk drug and Vonoprazan tablets 10mg/20mg was issued on 08-05-2024.

questions.question: On what date did CDSCO issue the 2024 new drug approval for Etifoxine Hydrochloride 50 mg capsules for anxiety?
questions.answer: The approval for Etifoxine Hydrochloride bulk drug and 50 mg capsules was issued on 21-03-2024.

questions.question: On what date did CDSCO issue the 2024 new drug approval for Tirzepatide prefilled pen injection for type 2 diabetes?
questions.answer: The approval for Tirzepatide solution for injection in a prefilled pen was issued on 19-01 2024.
